title: The Strategist’s Alibi
genre: philosophical argument through a fictional AI audit
narrativeSpine: Accurate strategic diagnosis can excuse inaction, while tactical success can externalize costs; a two-sided audit tests insight by consequence and scale.
firstSceneDraft: The Strategist's Alibi begins with an AI judge examining twenty-five years of unfinished clarity.
Its literary audit asks how accurate explanations can protect someone from consequential action.
The book combines fictional scenes with an argument about strategy, feedback, and responsibility.
A correct diagnosis does not by itself make another person's next step easier.
visualActionProposal: A lived workroom of unfinished mechanisms, loose strands becoming a load-bearing rope, and a shared well affected by successful local work; cobalt, coral and bright gold.
